convertibility_reason: Uses iCustom to load 'HighsLowsSignal' custom indicator and includes external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library for all trade execution logic (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose, GlobalVariableDel_, LoadHistory, CIsNewBar). Custom indicator and external library make auto-conversion impossible.

derived_values.name: min_rates_total - minimum bars required for calculation

other_exits: Historical signal scan: when both buy-open+buy-close or sell-open+sell-close are enabled but no close signal from current bar, the EA scans backward through bars to find the most recent opposite signal and sets the close flag accordingly (lines 123-148)
Exit permissions controlled by BuyPosClose and SellPosClose input booleans

position_sizing.conditional_logic: MarginMode enum selects sizing method: FREEMARGIN=deposit free funds fraction, BALANCE=balance fraction, LOSSFREEMARGIN=loss share from free margin, LOSSBALANCE=loss share from balance, LOT=fixed lot. Default is LOT (fixed lot unchanged). MM=0.1 is the fraction when not in LOT mode.

custom_logic_notes: The EA uses a custom indicator 'HighsLowsSignal' loaded via iCustom with 2 buffers: buffer 1 for up (buy) signals, buffer 0 for down (sell) signals. Signal is read at SignalBar offset (default=1, previous bar). A historical backward scan (lines 123-148) searches for the last opposite-direction signal to determine close signals when the current bar doesn't produce one - this only activates when both open and close permissions are enabled for the same direction. The Recount flag provides retry logic if CopyBuffer fails. Signal timestamps (UpSignalTime, DnSignalTime) are derived from SERIES_LASTBAR_DATE + TimeShiftSec, likely used by TradeAlgorithms.mqh for trade timing/expiration. The CIsNewBar class and LoadHistory/GlobalVariableDel_ functions come from the external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library.
python_conversion_notes: 1) The HighsLowsSignal custom indicator logic must be reimplemented in Python - it likely detects directional price changes over HowManyCandles consecutive bars. 2) TradeAlgorithms.mqh provides all order execution (BuyPositionOpen, SellPositionOpen, BuyPositionClose, SellPositionClose), lot calculation based on MarginMode enum, GlobalVariableDel_, and LoadHistory - these must be reimplemented or replaced with MT5 Python API equivalents. 3) The historical backward scan for close signals (lines 123-148) is non-trivial and must be carefully ported. 4) CIsNewBar class must be reimplemented for bar-change detection. 5) SL/TP are in points (not pips), so verify if the EA expects 5-digit broker adjustment - no explicit digit adjustment found in code, but the external library may handle this. 6) The signal timestamps (UpSignalTime/DnSignalTime) passed to open functions may implement trade expiration or next-bar-only entry logic that needs investigation in the library.
